opening_annotation.professional_name: Forge Fast Expand into Photon Cannon Defense
opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early defensive structure to secure expansion, followed by tech and production.
supporting_facts: The opening has a 98.1% rate of first static defense observed, compared to a 19.2% baseline.
The opening always includes a Forge (100% rate) versus a 28.4% baseline.
The medoid key sequence is 'Tech_Forge > Static_PhotonCannon > Prod_Gateway > Gas > Static_PhotonCannon2', indicating early Forge and Photon Cannons before Gateway and Gas.
The opening has a high technology investment (0.934) and defense investment (0.512), but low economy (0.340) and expansion (0.063) in the early profile.
